about_the_game:
This is a classic rolling ball game with very simple gameplay, just roll the ball to reach the end. The game boasts AAA game level technology such as ray tracing, global illumination, ambient occlusion, dynamic reflection and refraction, and also supports high dynamic range (HDR) display, everything is available. We have fully optimized the game and also support NVIDIA Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) and AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) technology, so you can have the most stunning graphics with just ordinary configuration. Everything about the game, from the user interface to the scene, and then to every object, intermingles with the light in just the right way and is as elegant as it can be. You'll be thrilled by the vibrant, gorgeous colors and dazzling, brilliant light in the game, which create real optical reactions with the objects in the scene. The game's realistic physics brings you in. We have also designed an endless number of balls for you to unlock, each of which is glorious. We've also designed countless levels so you can immerse yourself in them forever. The pace of the game is so relaxing that you can take a deserved break from rolling the ball. It's a world that needs to slow down.

Enjoy the world of rolling ball to the fullest!
